ShortDescription.Value: Turn a junction into a complete interchange in one placement (平改立)

Publish.LongDescription:
section2change (平改立) places a whole interchange at once: pick a type, aim at an existing junction or road (or empty ground), check the preview, confirm.
- 13 types: diamond, single-point, Chinese expressway node, cloverleaf, partial cloverleaf, roundabout, stack, turbine; T junctions: expressway T, trumpet, semi-directional T, directional T; three-way: wye - Aims at existing junctions and crossings, matches their roads, levels and angles, removes the old junction and reconnects the roads - Follows curved roads; levels by elevation, elevated or ground; ramp grades and clearances checked before placing - Auto mode: just point and confirm; manual mode: every parameter adjustable - Trumpet, directional / semi-directional T, stack, turbine and wye support right-hand traffic only. Beta: please report problems with a screenshot and the mod log
平改立：一次放下一整座立交。选类型，对准已有路口 / 道路（或空地），确认预览后放置；自动匹配原有道路、层高和角度，拆掉原路口并接回，弯道上整体顺着道路弯曲。

ChangeLog.Value: beta 1.0.5: ramps keep at least 3 m (default 4 m) from the main road; elevated diverges leave on an 80 m arc; wide two-way and two-way diamond mains split into carriageways; turbine / stack keep the full game clearance; wye matching is steadier and legs reconnect; interchanges on slopes follow one reference grade; reordered usage guide (placement cannot be undone)
